title: My Home and My Cat
text:
My house is small and blue. It has two windows and a red door. There is a big tree in the garden. The tree is very old.

My cat lives in the house too. She is black and white. She likes to sleep on the sofa. Her eyes are green.

questions.text: What color are the cat's eyes?
What kind of home does the writer probably have?
What can we guess about the cat?
options: It is probably calm and relaxed

vocabulary.definition: a small piece of land near a house where plants or trees grow
a long soft seat for two or more people
openings in a wall that let in light and air
having lived or existed for a long time

paragraph_translations: Minha casa é pequena e azul. Ela tem duas janelas e uma porta vermelha. Há uma árvore grande no jardim. A árvore é muito velha.
Meu gato também mora na casa. Ela é preta e branca. Ela gosta de dormir no sofá. Os olhos dela são verdes.
